newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Richter sell-off may bring raise capital.
newsitem.headline: Richter sell-off may bring raise capital.

text.p: The sell-off of Hungarian pharmaceuticals company Richter Gedeon Rt may be linked with a capital increase, the state privatisation agency APV Rt said on Wednesday.
"According to the preliminary plans, the transaction may be completed with a capital increase of Richter Gedeon Rt," APV said in a statement.
APV General Director Pal Szabo said earlier on Thursday that a private placement and a public issue of Richter shares was likely to come some time at the end of May.

APV did not disclose how many shares it planned to sell or in what amount Richter's capital should be raised, but it said the state-owned stake in Richter would be slightly larger than 25 percent following the transactions.
One trader told Reuters that Hungary may generate revenue of $160 million to $200 million from the capital increase, but APV gave no indication on that.
At December 31, 1996, APV had a 38.98 percent stake in Richter.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange Richter closed at 12,300 forints, down 200.
